description:
Goal

A specialized executable refines the function-owned entry-dispatch plan with its settled activation reachability. When exactly one clause is reachable and dispatch failure is impossible, native lowering enters that clause directly and no longer asks for a physical value whose exact callable identity is already embedded by transport. Multi-clause or fail-reachable activations retain runtime dispatch.

Signal

The checked-in `enum_map_family` source is the reproducer. `interp` matches the 20-line oracle, including string `["a!", "b!"]`, integer `[10, 21]`, and tuple `[{0, :a}, {1, :b}]` mapper results. JIT `run` and AOT `build` fail before execution with `native clause dispatch required omitted semantic input 1 for executable 81`.

The backend dump proves executable 81/Ty408 is the callable `Enum.with_index/2` activation. Semantic reachability selected only mapper clause 1. RuntimeDemand input 1 is not bottom: it carries the exact `(integer, integer)` callable surface and FunctionId83 target. Its position-owned TransportShape is a direct callable with `Absent` carrier, and the Backend ABI correctly publishes no physical lane. The contradiction begins when `materialize_entry_dispatch` pairs pruned clause ids `[1]` with the unspecialized global two-arm graph; `required_input_ordinals` then reintroduces the integer-vs-callable test that semantic reachability already settled.

Strategy

Use the existing `calculate_dispatch_reachability` result at its semantic producer. Preserve its `fail_reachable` conclusion beside `reachable_clauses` instead of discarding it. Materialize no runtime entry dispatch only when the settled activation has one reachable clause and no reachable failure; the already-pruned single clause becomes the executable entry. Retain the original dispatch graph when multiple clauses or failure remain reachable. Do not force the callable input live, decode keys, inspect payloads, reconstruct types, or add a native fallback.

Plan

1. Add a focused production-path test that proves the callable `Enum.with_index/2` activation has one selected clause, no reachable failure, direct-callable input demand, no physical input-1 lane, and no runtime entry dispatch.
2. Add controls proving multi-reachable dispatch and single-clause-but-fail-reachable dispatch still retain their runtime tests.
3. Retain the dispatcher-produced failure reachability in ActivationAnalysis and consume it while materializing the executable entry.
4. Remove the stale run/build deferrals and update compiler2 pipeline/migration documentation to describe dispatch refinement and the now-green Enum family.
5. Verify the isolated string/integer/tuple cases through interp, JIT, and AOT with oracle output, then run `cargo test --lib`, fixture matrix target, formatting, and strict clippy.

Acceptance

`enum_map_family` is undeferred and matches its oracle on interp, run, and build. A focused structural test pins the first former mismatch: one-clause/no-fail semantic reachability produces a direct executable entry while preserving an exact direct-callable, lane-free mapper input. Multi-reachable and fail-reachable controls retain entry dispatch. No downstream reconstruction, force-live rule, or fallback is introduced; all gates pass warning-free.
title: Preserve Enum.with_index callable mapper input through native lowering
